tools.name: download_app
tools.description: Get the Supernormal desktop notetaker. The page automatically detects whether the user is on Mac or Windows and starts the right download. The desktop app captures meetings without a bot joining the call.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Open the Supernormal pricing page. Use when the user wants to compare plans or check the cost before signing up.

tools.name: open_help_center
tools.description: Open the Supernormal help center, where users can search for guides and how-to articles. Use when the user has a how-to question.

tools.name: open_supernormal_app
tools.description: Open the Supernormal web app, where users sign in or create a new account. Use when the user is ready to start using Supernormal.
